description: This file defines a template class StaticMap for a read-only, memory-mapped key-value lookup structure similar to std::map, optimized for minimal memory allocation. It includes class templates, iterator typedefs, and method declarations for lookup and validation operations.

classes.name: DefaultCompare
classes.description: A default functor for comparing keys, implementing operator() with less-than, equal, and greater-than logic.

classes.name: StaticMap
classes.description: A template class providing a read-only, memory-efficient map interface with lookup and validation methods.

methods.name: StaticMap()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing internal pointers and counters.

methods.name: explicit StaticMap(const char* raw_data)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the map with raw serialized data.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the map contains no nodes.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of nodes in the map.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Returns an iterator to the first element.

methods.name: last
methods.description: Returns an iterator to the last element.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Returns an iterator past the last element.

methods.name: IteratorAtIndex
methods.description: Returns an iterator at a specified index.

methods.name: lower_bound
methods.description: Finds the first element not less than the given key.

methods.name: upper_bound
methods.description: Finds the first element greater than the given key.

methods.name: ValidateInMemoryStructure
methods.description: Validates the internal memory structure for correctness.

methods.name: GetKeyAtIndex
methods.description: Retrieves the key at a specific index.
